moments.text: Too many things at once, work launch, a sick kid, and moving flat were still hard.

You took a five minute walk before answering emails.

You noticed you felt exhausted but proud of how you handled the move.

skills_full.name: Picking one thing for today
skills_full.in_your_words: When too many things pile up, you choose one thing for the day and stop there. You use it when work, home, and family needs all land at once.

skills_full.name: Asking for help sooner
skills_full.in_your_words: You ask your partner, friend, or manager for help before everything gets too big. That can mean school runs, packing boxes, or asking for an extension.

skills_full.name: Resting without pushing on
skills_full.in_your_words: You leave some things undone on purpose, then rest. You also let yourself do one thing a day, instead of filling the whole day up.

skills_full.name: Noticing when you feel lighter
skills_full.in_your_words: You notice when your body and mood shift, like feeling slightly lighter after writing a list and choosing one thing. You also notice when you ask for help sooner.
